title: Studio formula inspector: a kept currency return type goes stale when an edit stops computing money
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

From seat 5's contract review delta d1 of PR #35565 (#35047), comment 7018560972, N6. This does not hold that PR.

## Defect
Since #35565, the Studio field inspector's `returnType` stamp (`settleFormulaType` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`) keeps a declared `currency` under a `number` or unproven verdict, because the verdict it reads (`inferExpressionType`) never answers `currency`. So when an author edits a money formula into one that no longer computes money (for example `record.amount * 0.1` becomes `count(record.lines)`), the field keeps `returnType: 'currency'` and its `currencyConfig`, and the result is shown as an amount.

## Done when
The inspector stamp asks `@objectstack/formula`'s `inferFormulaReturn` for the currency verdict. That verdict can prove money (stamp `currency`) or withdraw it (a `number` verdict then replaces a stale `currency`). Pins: an edit from a money expression to a count drops `currency`; an edit that still proves money keeps it; CONTROL: a declared `percent` is still kept under a `number` verdict.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:ui. A stale display type after an authoring edit; the stored value is unaffected.
